issues.detail: R1 example contradicts S0 pass-through: after first 1 (row3) state should become S1 next cycle, but example only shows z=1 which is consistent; however R1 example never shows post-first-1 behavior, and R1 condition says z=x in S0 while R3 says first 1 passed through—consistent. Real issue: R1 example row3 x=1 expected z=1 is fine, but no contradiction. Reclassify: R1 example lacks reset row and starts mid-stream, so S0 meaning 'all bits so far are 0' is violated by row3 x=1 while still S0.

issues.detail: R4 example row1 areset=0 x=1 expected z=1 assumes initial S0; row2 areset=1 expected z=0; row3 areset=0 x=0 expected z=0. After reset release, S0 with x=0 gives z=0, consistent. No contradiction.

Spec says conversion begins when Reset is released; contract says no combinational conversion on deassertion and first posedge samples x. Alternative: conversion/output valid immediately upon deassertion using current x.

issues.alternative: On areset deassertion, z immediately reflects x per current state (S0 pass-through) without waiting for posedge.
